verdict.rationale: Llama is distributed primarily as open weights via partners/Hugging Face and a CLI for download/verification; there is no evidence of a first-party Llama API service mirroring a Meta-hosted UI's capabilities. Probes show no OpenAPI spec (llama-probe-2) and even developer docs are gated behind an SSO wall (llama-supp-docs-gated), undermining any claim of API/UI parity.
